ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant high-intensity white pixels (approx. 75% surface area) and low-intensity black pixels (approx. 25% surface area) concentrated in the central-basal region and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity contiguous blob originating from the peduncle base, tapering toward the notch. Continuous low-intensity banding along the entire trailing edge margin. Isolated low-intensity punctate spots visible in the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured interior angle of approximately 52 degrees; vertical depth measures approximately 1/6th of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Pixel-amplitude of variations is highest on the inner margins near the notch, characterized by jagged peaks; transitions to lower-amplitude, more frequent ripples toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory follows a broad convex curve from the base to the mid-lobe, transitioning into a concave upward sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white-on-black circular pixel groupings localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicative of colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-intensity linear disruptions (scratches) visible on the left lobe mid-section, primarily oriented at a 45-degree angle to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notches and tissue loss on the extreme terminal edges of both fluke tips; rake-like linear markings on the lower-left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'fountain' pigmentation pattern where the central low-intensity region bifurcates around the median notch.
